$comment: X402-51 (G, ADR-005) — SKALE + PayAI single-rail facilitator-fitness acceptance fixture. Contributor: TKCollective (AgentOracle, https://agentoracle.co). Closes the SKALE+PayAI commitment from #103 (https://github.com/fardinvahdat/x402trace/pull/103#issuecomment) targeting end-of-week 2026-06-05/06; landed early on 2026-06-03 ahead of the AgentOracle SKALE Developer Showcase (2026-06-04, 09:30 PT, streamyard.com/z5q2kcdcui). Tests G's per-rail facet emission on a non-CDP rail: AgentOracle's /deep-research/skale declares extensions.bazaar.facilitator: payai; the registry probe resolves payai → https://facilitator.payai.network/supported which returns 200 + an eip155:1187947933 entry in kinds[], so fitness collapses to ok. Per ADR-005 the identity source must be the declared facilitator field, not tx-from inference — load-bearing here because SKALE is gasless and the on-chain tx originates from the facilitator's settler key, not the merchant's payTo, so any tx-from inference would mis-attribute the rail. The looks-correct merchant manifest in mocks below is the X402-51 commitment shape for AgentOracle's SKALE rail; the real on-chain anchors (PayAI facilitator, settle tx, block, chainId) are reproduced verbatim from production captures on 2026-06-03 (settle tx 0x9b5cf04dda211d3bae1218e9b5ebecd17119b6f28372714056b774b47103e875 on SKALE Base block-explorer https://skale-base.blockscout.com/tx/0x9b5cf04dda211d3bae1218e9b5ebecd17119b6f28372714056b774b47103e875 + prior anchor 0x809361edad3ea6aebfacea978c6d6acf8cb32f7f03e4b5d13ee070e00c9f8e42 block 1925417). Pair-completes the multi-rail CDP fixture (anchor-x402-facilitator-fitness-ok-multi-rail.json) by exercising the same G probe against a non-CDP rail end-to-end. Receipt-spec cross-reference: https://github.com/TKCollective/agentoracle-receipt-spec/tree/v0.3-binary-halt (v_recommendation / v_gate / v_gate_mapping ride alongside the rail, not at the rail layer).
